data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mareah is recorded in name-lists as “Rebellion, revolt”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mareah expresses “Rebellion, revolt”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mareah total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Μαρεά
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'maraino' meaning 'to rejoice'. In the Bible, Mareah is mentioned as the name of a place (Genesis 21:14) and a woman (Exodus 2:16).

biblical_reference.note: Mareah is mentioned as a place where Hagar and Ishmael were cast out (Genesis 21:14), and as the name of a woman who was the wet nurse of Moses (Exodus 2:16).
